snippet.title: Crimson Capes - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488540/Crimson_Capes/
JOIN OUR DISCORD:  http://discord.gg/DD4JW2bQ8F

A unique Sword & Sorcery Action-RPG in development by Poor Locke.

Play as a witch-hunter tasked by the King to take down a conspiracy of wizards. Track your targets, raid old ruins and magic towers, explore dark caverns and mystical forests, hone your skills with the blade and absorb the powers of your enemies. 

Experience the age of high adventure!
